newsitem.title: POLAND: Kredyt Bank two new issues cleared.
newsitem.headline: Kredyt Bank two new issues cleared.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) approved two new share issues of Kredyt Bank SA directed to the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and the general public, the KPW said on Tuesday.

It said in a statement an issue of between 7.5 million and 10 million shares would be offered in public subscription scheduled for February 17-21 in a two-million-share retail tranche and eight-million share offer for large investors.
The EBRD will be offered 635,000-847,000 shares in March 17-19. Kredyt Bank has now 25.6 million shares outstanding.
